topic: the drill panel must not crash the statement it overlays
lesson: drill-panel.tsx throws an Error DURING RENDER when the flattened leaves do not foot to the clicked node. There is no error boundary anywhere in this frontend - no frontend/app/error.tsx, no global-error.tsx, no componentDidCatch - so in the Next.js App Router that throw unmounts the tree and the user loses the statement they were reading, with no route back but a reload. The invariant is right and must stay (parents are derived subtotals under decision 0020, so a mismatch is a real defect and the panel must never show a total it cannot vouch for); the FAILURE MODE is wrong. Keep the check, and instead of throwing render the panel in a refusal state that names what happened in the interface's voice - the leaves do not sum to the line's Actual, so the total is withheld - leaving the leaf rows visible and the statement underneath fully usable. Assert the refusal state in a test rather than asserting that render throws.
